newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $1.4 bln for Wednesday, March 19.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $1.4 bln for Wednesday, March 19.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Wednesday, March 19 are expected to total $1.4 billion in 32 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.2 billion in 22 sales, with a $316 million Palm Beach County deal through Smith Barney Inc. topping the the list.
On the competitive side, 10 sales totaling $289 million are on the schedule, a $226 million Louisiana deal at 1100 EST is the largest.

An additional five sales totaling $62 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Wednesday, depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
